title: Multi-epoch non-normal transfer
statement: Convert a structured covariance gap into a uniform all-k expected-distance estimate, explicitly controlling block length, prefactors, reachable states, and incomplete final blocks.

signature.representation: Powers or blocks of the RPCD covariance operator on PSD and reachable rank-one states
signature.state_or_invariant: A power-bounded cone norm with explicit block contraction and transient prefactor
signature.core_candidate_lemma: A block contraction proportional to block_length times mu, with a universal prefactor, extends to every epoch count and expectation of A-distance.
information_discarded: asymptotic spectral radius without a finite-time prefactor
signature.target_implication: This is the final direct edge from an operator gap to C050 and the O((n/mu) log(1/epsilon)) update count.
signature.known_failure_mode: An asymptotic rate with a dimension-dependent condition number or transient prefactor does not prove C050.
signature.verifier_class: operator-power identity, cone-invariance, prefactor, and finite-time complexity audit
